text: ほれ　そのために…　ひつような　どうぐを　わたそう！

structure.jp: ひつような　どうぐを　わたそう！
structure.en: I'll hand you the tools you need!

patterns.name: 〜ために
patterns.explanation: ために says what something is done for. そのために = 'for that purpose'.

patterns.name: 〜よう (intention)
patterns.explanation: Changing the end of a verb to the おう sound says 'I'll do it' or 'let's do it'. わたそう = 'I'll hand it over'.
